method: One analyst viewed the four raw 2025 Cook orthophotos at 480 m width after source-blind center selection and before viewing ROW land candidates or motorway-exposure values. Approximate 1000-pixel rings identify every visibly complete ordinary street-bounded block in these four views, subject to ambiguity at the expressway edge. Points mark non-block freeway/ramp landscape. This is not surveyed boundary truth.

caveat: The H3 wedge street status is visual only; needs street-source check before a definitive block label. The original narrower 320 m images lacked enough full blocks, so the same frozen centers were re-exported at 480 m width before candidate viewing.
